text:
**Wednesday**, and you open the Biology period with your organelles talk. Bring the rubric. Breathe before the first slide, not during it. Tae Kwon Do is later than usual today, at 5:10.

Once it is done, tonight has nothing urgent in it, which is rare enough to notice. A short round on whatever you have been putting off is plenty. The rest of the evening is yours, and the Wonder Jar has room for one good thing from today.
